sources.entry: WBO - Web Whiteboard to collaborate in real-time on schemas, drawings, and notes. (Demo) AGPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: WBO is a self-hosted online collaborative whiteboard where many users draw together in real time on a large virtual board, with boards saved as SVG files.
summary.what_it_does: Multiple connected users see each other's edits live on a shared board. The server stores each board as an SVG file in a configurable history directory. Boards can be opened by URL, and a standalone SVG preview can be downloaded from a /preview/ path. Optional JWT authentication (AUTH_SECRET_KEY) restricts access with global or board-scoped roles (reader, editor, moderator), and read-only boards can be set via an attribute in the SVG file. Moderators can warn, ban, and revoke bans, and rate limits per IP are configurable. The app is available in multiple languages, and can be served under a subfolder behind a reverse proxy.
use_cases: teaching math or lessons on a shared board
self-hosted alternative for shared note-taking on a canvas
embedding a board under a subfolder behind a reverse proxy
stack: JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for optional authentication
notable: Boards are saved as SVG files, with a standalone SVG preview endpoint
Board-scoped and global roles (reader, editor, moderator) via signed JWT tokens
Configurable per-IP rate limits for drawing, constructive, and destructive actions
Read-only boards toggled by a data attribute in the board SVG
Reverse proxy subfolder support via WBO_BASE_PATH and trusted IP header options
caveats: Accepted edits are saved asynchronously, so a crash can lose recent changes; only one server process per history directory is supported
Without AUTH_SECRET_KEY, anyone with a board URL can edit writable boards
Subfolder hosting requires setting up a reverse proxy
keywords: share a drawing board with my team
